conclusion: NP-155F is the documented calculator family for 4-8 layers. It is a plausible prototype material for the short USB4 routes. Complete channel loss acceptance remains unverified.

manufacturerStatements.fact: The 4-8 layer calculator uses Nan Ya NP-155F core material. The matching material must be selected when ordering.
The factory chooses among listed base materials unless the customer specifies a material at ordering. The stackup code does not uniquely assign a laminate.
